quotes: You're committing a serious crime if you don't get the artichoke dip to start.
Incredibly mediocre. My husband compared his pancakes to cafeteria food.

themes.label: Cocktails and drinks
themes.text: Reviewers frequently single out the cocktails and bartenders as excellent, with the house Freemans cocktail mentioned favorably.
quotes: The cocktail list was inventive, and I was tempted by at least two thirds of the options available.
Still great cocktails & ambience but food took a weird turn.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Several reviewers found the food and drinks overpriced for what they were, while a few called the prices fair or great.
quotes: the food was just not worth it especially because of its price tag. There are much better options in the area.
Amazing food, great prices!

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise attentive, impeccable service, but several describe slow, inattentive or disorganized staff, long gaps between visits, and a rude host.
quotes: Incredible service & the food is so well done - the fusilli & octopus is awesome
Dirty plates sat on the table for 20 minutes before being bussed.

themes.label: Pasta dishes
themes.text: Pasta, especially the fusilli with octopus, is repeatedly called outstanding or the best, though a couple of reviewers found some pasta heavy or too salty.
quotes: The best pasta in New York City
The pastas can be a bit heavy, but they're good.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Many say the set or tasting menu is good value and worth the cost, while others note it is pricey or not matching the price.
quotes: Had the set menu, which was great value for money and by no means left us hungry!
Delicious overall, but a natural level when compared to price.

themes.label: Seafood quality
themes.text: Reviewers praise fresh seafood, including crudo, octopus, scallops, oysters, uni and lobster.
quotes: Fresh and well prepared seafood
The oysters were also very fresh with a sweet taste.

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: The room is described as lovely, classy and pleasant, with a comfortable setting near Central Park.
quotes: cozy and classy setting across the street from Central Park.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise attentive, helpful staff, but several describe rude hosts, seating problems and poor or inattentive waiters.
quotes: Great attentive service. Dinner is always impressive and portions are pretty generous.
the maitre d ', a detestable character like some that appear in American movies, made us wait while he sat down the acquaintances

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Many reviewers call the restaurant expensive; some feel the food justifies the cost, while others see poor value.
quotes: Expensive but worth it.
$27 for a tomato & onion salad and $19 for a bowl of lental soup was too much

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Many find the food delicious and consistent, but some call it bland, basic or poor value for the quality.
quotes: Food is consistently great, especially their pasta dishes.
Food with no taste at all. How come? Such a shame!

themes.label: Desserts and drinks
themes.text: Reviewers single out the meringue cake, baked Alaska and Bellini as highlights.
quotes: seriously the best cake I've ever eaten in my life
And when in Cipriani you must try their signature drink Bellini.

themes.label: Crowded scene
themes.text: Some enjoy the trendy, celebrity-filled, lively crowd, while others find the room too crowded, noisy and stuffy.
quotes: Extra star, due to the extremely beautiful, and trendy crowd.
Very stuffy and noisy. Not a cosy place.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most reviewers praise attentive, knowledgeable, friendly service, though a few found it below expectations or had small lapses.
quotes: Fantastic restaurant, impeccable service. Highly imaginative menu, worthy of the reviews. Excellent.
The Staff and service was impeccable and everyone is friendly, our table was always clean and our glass was always full.

themes.label: Tasting menu and dishes
themes.text: Reviewers love the inventive, beautifully presented Nordic dishes and chef's tasting menu, though a few found some courses ordinary or flat.
quotes: The Chef's tasting menu is amazing. Incredible amount of care put into every dish, adjusted based on what's in season
there were some highs such as the sea bass and langoustine courses but a few courses fell flat such as the main lamb dish

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Many call it expensive, some still find it worth the cost or reasonable, while others felt the price was not justified.
quotes: So expensive but every plate is an amazing gastronomical experience.
The food was of a high quality but overall I didn't feel it worthy of the very high price tag.

themes.label: Arctic Bird's Nest dessert
themes.text: The signature Arctic Bird's Nest dessert is widely praised as clever and delicious, though one reviewer found its taste pedestrian.
quotes: The dessert was the best part - called the bird's nest - it was clever and delicious.
the taste of milk chocolate and berries was somewhat pedestrian

themes.label: Decor and atmosphere
themes.text: Many describe the room as elegant, warm or modern, while others found it minimalistic, outdated or noisy.
quotes: what lovely, warm ambience! Excellent service too, we loved dining in the bar this time.
The décor was a bit minimalistic. Felt a little like I was eating in a church hall.

themes.label: Live piano entertainment
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the live piano bar and singalongs, including the performer Chicken Delicious, as fun and a main reason to visit.
quotes: Live music with Chicken Delicious or Barry is always enjoyable.
Great food and awesome atmosphere with piano player.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Many call the Italian food good or delicious, while others find dishes bland, greasy, canned-tasting or not authentically Italian.
quotes: It's the best Italian food I've had in a long time.
The lasagna lacks freshness, dry and tasteless.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Many describe friendly, welcoming staff and great service, but several report rude, tired or poor service and a forced tip.
quotes: The staff is friendly and welcoming.
this place has terrible service, the people are extremely rude for no reason whatsoever

themes.label: Atmosphere and old-school charm
themes.text: Reviewers like the lively, cozy, old New York feel of the room, though one finds it very loud.
quotes: Not fancy/trendy/upscale in any way, but a lot of character
It's very loud, I mean very loud, in this restaurant.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Some find prices reasonable or good, while others say the food and wine are over-priced or object to added gratuity.
quotes: The price is reasonable compared to other restaurants.
Food was good, but over-priced.

themes.label: Friendly, attentive staff
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, attentive bar and waiting staff who made them feel welcome, though a few describe unpleasant encounters with bouncers and a manager.
quotes: I've never felt more welcome at a bar in a city full of strangers.
Phenomenal staff - had the absolute pleasure of working w this bar for a fundraising happy hour

themes.label: Live music
themes.text: Live music is frequently mentioned as a highlight, though one reviewer found its quality uneven and others found it loud.
quotes: Live music of uneven quality - not great, but certainly listenable.
Free live music on Fridays from 9pm to 12am

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Reviewers generally enjoyed the food, naming burgers, sliders, fish and chips, chicken fingers and soups, with one lukewarm comment on shepherd's pie.
quotes: Chicken fingers were excellent...light batter, large pieces of white meat chicken.
Fantastic fish and chips, drinks weren't overly expensive, very friendly bartender.

themes.label: Neighborhood Irish pub atmosphere
themes.text: Many describe a cosy, easygoing local Irish pub with a good vibe, though one calls it generic among many similar pubs.
quotes: Generic Irish pub in a sea of generic Irish pubs in the area.
Like "Cheers", a real neighborhood bar.

themes.label: Drink prices and happy hour
themes.text: Reviewers mostly find prices reasonable and like the long happy hour, though one calls it a bit pricey and another notes $7-8 pints.
quotes: Extra long happy hour from 11am - 8pm!

themes.label: Falafel quality
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly call the falafel the best in downtown Brooklyn or NYC, and several name it as their go-to order.
quotes: Best falafel in downtown Brooklyn. More than that, fresh elastic pita keeps all the tasty mess inside the pita
I love their Falafels so much that I havent ventured past them on the menu.

themes.label: Friendly attentive service
themes.text: Staff and the owner are described as friendly and attentive, checking that customers are happy and greeting them with a smile.
quotes: Friendly staff and the owner took the time out to make sure everything was ok.
Amazing service! the place was clean and the staff was super friendly.

themes.label: Hummus
themes.text: Several reviewers say the hummus is the most delicious they have eaten, with some calling it the best in NYC.
quotes: I ate the most delicious hummus in the area ... and left satisfied
The best hummus in NYC, by far

themes.label: Shakshuka and sabich
themes.text: Diners enjoyed the sabich sandwich and the shakshuka, describing the sabich as filling and generously made.
quotes: My sabich was made with a generous portion of tahini and a tea egg—filling and delicious.
I ordered the shakshuka , and gor desert i ordered the malabi

themes.label: Friendly, efficient service
themes.text: Most reviewers praise attentive, friendly and quick staff, though a few describe a rude host or disinterested, rushed service.

Host aggressively moved us out of a booth we had been sat in by another employee.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Many call prices reasonable or good value, while others find the diner overpriced for what it serves.
quotes: the prices are reasonable
Not bad for a diner, but very overpriced.

themes.label: Large portions
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly mention giant, generous portions, with one wishing servings were bigger for the price.
quotes: Good food, mega portions.
I wish the servings were a bit bigger for the price.

themes.label: Retro diner atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers like the vintage decor, comfortable seating and nostalgic feel of the room.
quotes: Loved the interior and the retro feel of the place.
Very nostalgic late 50's, early to mid 60's vibe.

themes.label: Open late hours
themes.text: Reviewers value that the diner is open around the clock, including for late-night and post-bar meals.
quotes: Open around the clock and full of friendly staff.
Open very late for good post bar munchies

themes.label: Open 24 hours
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the round-the-clock opening, especially for late-night and early-morning meals.
quotes: where else can you go and get a quality steak frites at 4am and a nice glass of red
A 24 hour french restaurant. Enough said.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Many describe friendly, attentive staff, but others report slow, rude or inattentive servers and wrong orders.

I've been waiting for my menu for over 10 mins and my check for more than 15mins

themes.label: Steak tartare and escargot

quotes: the beef tartar is very delicious and the escargot is amazing
Also the Escargots Bourguignonne is addictive.

themes.label: Lamb burger
themes.text: The lamb burger is recommended and called delicious and large, though one reviewer found it mostly bread and onion.
quotes: recommended the lamb burger and it was delicious
Ordered the lamb burger and it was big enough for two people to share.

themes.label: Prices and tipping
themes.text: Some find prices reasonable for the quality, while others call it slightly overpriced or object to automatic high tips.
quotes: Solid lunch and well priced based on the quality and area
Good, basic French fare, slightly overpriced, but open 24 hours!!!

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the French dishes, fries, mussels and brunch, though a few call the food only okay or mediocre.
quotes: Absolutely loved the salmon tartare and tomato tartine!
The food, which seemed to hold the place together, is just mediocre; except for the mussels

themes.label: Service
themes.text: Service is mostly described as attentive, friendly and excellent, with a few complaints of slow or overly rushed service.
quotes: Our server was friendly and available while not intruding and helpful with the menu.
The service was very attentive, and the food was delicious, as was my cocktail.

themes.label: Atmosphere and crowds
themes.text: Most enjoy the lively, trendy room and people-watching, while some find it too crowded, loud or pretentious.
quotes: lively, fun, always packed but good ambiance and attentive service despite the crowds.
It's always way too crowded, mostly with European tourists.

themes.label: Prices
themes.text: Several reviewers find Pastis expensive, though one praises its affordable wines and another calls the price decent.
quotes: Nice food and ambient, but quite expensive...
It also is on the pricier end.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise attentive, friendly staff, but a minority describe gruff, absent or unprofessional service and slow attention.
quotes: Wonderful dinner and the service was top notch!
After we were seated our waiter disappeared for 20 mins.

themes.label: Steak quality
themes.text: Steaks are widely called excellent or perfect, though some found them dry, fatty, flavourless or underwhelming.

my steak is always a little dry, medium instead of medium rare

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Several reviewers think the price is too high for the quality, while others accept it or say it is worth it.
quotes: The price is too high compared to quality.
Very pricey but the steaks are very good

themes.label: Classic atmosphere
themes.text: Many enjoy the lively, classic steakhouse feel and decor, though a couple find it dated, stuffy or unwelcoming.

this is a massive boys club and feels very stuffy and at times unwelcoming

themes.label: Friendly attentive service
themes.text: Reviewers frequently praise friendly, attentive staff and bartenders, even when busy, though one found bartenders cold and another felt unfairly treated.
quotes: Staff is attentive even when they're packed.
Excellent attention and good prices. Most importantly ... they don't rush you.

themes.label: Burgers and pretzel bun
themes.text: Most reviewers like the burgers, especially the pretzel bun, but some found them undercooked, simple or lacking flavor.
quotes: The burgers were great on the pretzel bun!
The burger was simple. Not anything that you wouldn't find in other places.

themes.label: Prices and daily specials
themes.text: Many reviewers describe prices as reasonable or good value for the city, with daily specials and cheap oysters, though two found it a bit pricey.
quotes: Allday $1 Oyster is value for money !
Great food and customer service. Just a bit pricey.

themes.label: Spacious cozy atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers like the roomy, comfortable space with a balcony, TVs for sports and fairly low noise, though some found it loud or crowded.

TV screens are everywhere but do not feel intrusive to those who just want to have a conversation.

themes.label: Friendly bartenders and staff

quotes: That staff is absolutely amazing! The nachos are awesome!
Very friendly barman, relatively cheap drinks for where it is.

themes.label: Karaoke and trivia nights
themes.text: Reviewers enjoy the Wednesday trivia with cheap beers and the karaoke, though some find the upstairs karaoke noisy and crowded.

it's extremely noisy because of the karaoke bar upstairs

themes.label: Food quality and lunch specials
themes.text: Food is mostly called good, with pulled pork, shepherd's pie, nachos and burgers singled out, and a lunch special seen as good value.
quotes: Dollar beers and a really solid pulled pork sandwich... What a place!
very good shepherd pie and a drink (local beers) or non-alcoholic is very good value for money

themes.label: Drink prices and deals
themes.text: Most reviewers find drinks cheap or good value, with dollar beers mentioned, but a couple say prices or tipping were poor.
quotes: drinks are on point, and affordable.
the bartender thought she deserved a $20 tip for 6 drinks.

themes.label: Sports viewing atmosphere
themes.text: The bar is liked for watching sports, including football, basketball and Kansas Jayhawks games, with staff changing channels on request.

Cool place to watch KU Jayhawk games!

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the service as professional, attentive and friendly, though a couple found it rushed, fussy or brusque.

the Prime Rib was unbelievable - plus the service was incredibly attentive

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Many call it very expensive, with some saying the experience justifies the splurge and others saying the quality does not match the cost.
quotes: Very expensive place to eat but worth the splurge when the right things hit the table.
Good food over priced for what it is

themes.label: Elegant historic atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers admire the opulent, historic room and classic ambiance, though one found the atmosphere bland like an office building.
quotes: You'll experience an elegant decor, impeccable service, and a taste of history
The room is elegant and has a great vibe.

themes.label: Steak and prime rib
themes.text: Steaks, prime rib and filet mignon are singled out as standout dishes, though one reviewer found the prime rib tough.
quotes: It was one of the best steaks I had in the city so I didn't regret it too much
Prime rib @ $75 was tough and not tender.

themes.label: Cocktails and bar
themes.text: Reviewers praise the cocktails, martinis and knowledgeable bartenders, and the bar scene.
quotes: Outstanding cocktails, especially the martinis, and a knowledgeable and accommodating bar staff who remember your name.

themes.label: Large portions

Kids spaghetti was enough for two adults, their corndbeef and pastrami shot sandwich was great and was enough for two meals.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Many find prices high, with several angry about specific bills, while others call them fair or reasonable for New York's East Side.

plentiful and at a fair price for New York.

themes.label: Staff and service

Unfriendly staff, but can't tell how the food is since we decided to leave after the first, unfriendly experience

themes.label: Breakfast dishes

French toast was soft and delicious.

themes.label: Food quality

themes.label: Food quality

themes.label: Service
themes.text: Servers and staff are described as pleasant, accommodating and excellent, though one reviewer found service very slow and another found it merely fine.
quotes: service is maybe the best I have ever had all the times I have been there.
Always polite and very entertaining.

themes.label: French fries

quotes: the fries alone guaranteed this 5 star review

themes.label: High prices

quotes: The food is good but pricy.

themes.label: Quiet atmosphere

great food, great atmosphere with great service.

quotes: The service, just the best in the entirety of New York City.
thanks to the kindness, knowledge and warmth of a team that you can tell love what they do

themes.label: Brunch
themes.text: Brunch is repeatedly described as excellent, with praise for specific dishes, though one reviewer complains the omelette was skimpy.
quotes: Possibly the best brunch I ever had.
Wonderful brunch! My mum and I loved this place.

themes.label: Small cramped space

quotes: It's a tight fit so if you're afraid of small space a or like to spread out this isn't the spot for you.

themes.label: Cocktails and drinks
themes.text: Reviewers enjoy the cocktails, especially the Bloody Mary, and the knowledgeable bartenders, though one finds the Bloody Mary pricey.
quotes: Great cocktails, try the Magdalena. Very friendly bartenders.

themes.label: Price and portions

quotes: the food is slightly pricey drinks are as well pricey

themes.label: The burger

themes.label: Long waits for tables

quotes: 1 hour and a half to get a table and when we finally got one, 50 minutes after we placed our order the food arrived!

themes.label: Staff and service

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor

the whole place has a great vibe

themes.label: High prices

service could be better, by knowing who order what, when serving.

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Several reviewers find the restaurant very expensive, though some say the quality justifies the cost and one notes small portions.
quotes: It's a beautiful restaurant but crazy expensive. Not a everyday restaurant but a very special day restaurant.
It can be a bit pricey, but the quality and service back it up.

themes.label: Brunch buffet and mimosas
themes.text: Reviewers enjoy the brunch buffet with unlimited mimosas, though one notes some dishes were unavailable and advises arriving early.
quotes: Sunday brunches are excellent, drink as much mimosa as you can for only $38.
Really great selection for the brunch buffet, and unlimited mimosas.

themes.label: Friendly, attentive service
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, attentive staff and servers, though a few describe a rude barman or a grumpy bartender.
quotes: She was lively, friendly, attentive and kind. The food is always great here.
Great place for a drink or a quick bite to eat. Staff are super friendly!

themes.label: Burgers
themes.text: Burgers, especially the bison burger, are widely called among the best in NYC, though one reviewer found theirs overcooked and another thought several places beat it.
quotes: New York's best burger. Just a gorgeous and unchanged old New York pub.
The bison burger was moist and cooked properly. Vary tasty.

themes.label: Reasonable prices
themes.text: Reviewers frequently describe the food and drinks as cheap, good value or reasonably priced for NYC.
quotes: Cheap strong drinks and a chill atmosphere. Can't beat those prices anywhere in SoHo.
Great American food at reasonable prices. Many New Yorker guests.

themes.label: Historic old-New York atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers love the old-fashioned, historic, cozy pub feel and classic SoHo character, though one calls it cramped and dim and another says it is only historically interesting.
quotes: historic bar in the soho district! You feel like you are living in another era!
Cramped and dim-lit, time-worn decor, and the place had the lighting conditions in midnight although I came here afternoon.

themes.label: Bathroom and cleanliness
themes.text: A couple of reviewers complain about a disgusting men's bathroom and a chlorine smell, while another praises cleanliness.
quotes: But I just can't accept how disgusting the male bathroom was.
Good bira. The whole place smells like chlorine though

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Reviewers praise the food as delicious and authentic, naming dishes such as gnocchi, veal, branzino, cannoli and rabbit, though a few found it only ok or meh.
quotes: The pear gorgonzola gnocchi is absolutely to die for! I could eat it every day of my life.
The food is absolutely delicious. Best I have had outside of Italy (and better than some inside as well).

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most reviewers describe the staff as attentive, accommodating and warm, though a few mention spotty or slow service and being rushed.
quotes: The staff was extremely knowledgeable, polite, and accommodating, since I'm vegan and all, they made something special for me
Excellent service and superb food. Wait staff are very accommodating.

themes.label: Atmosphere and room
themes.text: Many describe a quiet, romantic, cozy, old-world room, though one reviewer found it old and smelly and another found it dated.
quotes: Romantic restaurant with an old world vibe, Frank Sinatra discreetly playing in the background.
It's so nice to actually be able to hear people at dinner in the City.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Many call it pricey, and wine prices drew complaints, but several feel the food is worth the cost or fairly priced.
quotes: Fantastic classic italian dishes (quite expensive, but worth every penny).
Fair prices for great food, including the wine list.

themes.label: Grilled Mexican street corn
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly single out the grilled corn as a must-order, calling it amazing, juicy and delicious, though one found it dry and hard.
quotes: The grill corn is amazing, but the Cuban sandwich is the sandwich that I will dreaming about tonight.
You have to try the corn , very yummy.

themes.label: Cuban sandwich
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the Cuban sandwich as delicious and generous, but a few found it dry, underseasoned or not the best in the city.
quotes: The Cuban sandwich I had was delicious. And gigantic!!!
Got a Cuban, but it was terribly dry and underseasoned for my tastes.

themes.label: Small cramped space
themes.text: The room is described as tiny, crowded and sometimes uncomfortable, though several reviewers find it cozy, lively and part of the charm.
quotes: Uncomfortably cramped -- three of us at a very tiny table meant for two people.
Small, cozy, packed and homely pretty much says it all about this cafe.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Many reviewers praise friendly, great or fast service, while others report unprofessional staff, rigid seating rules and neglected cleanliness.
quotes: Very authentic food with great service.
If I could give this place less than one star I would. The staff was so unprofessional.

themes.label: Breakfast and brunch
themes.text: Several reviewers enjoy the breakfast and brunch dishes, such as the breakfast burrito and steak and eggs, though one found breakfast food disappointing.
quotes: Amazing flavor in their breakfast burrito and so stuffed!
I just love this place with the best breakfasts!

themes.label: Staff friendliness and service
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, attentive staff, but some report slow, forgetful, rude or indifferent service and wrong orders.
quotes: the friendliness of the staff here, blows me away. It makes a nice change in NYC!
Waitress was very rude, messed up the order many times.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Many call the food delicious and fresh, while others find it bland, stale, undercooked or low quality.
quotes: the food was terrible and tasteless

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Reviewers often describe the diner as reasonably priced or cheap for Manhattan, though quality is sometimes seen as matching the low cost.
quotes: Never thought I could find comfort food at reasonable prices.
Economical for NYC, quality proportionate to the cost

themes.label: Cleanliness and hygiene
themes.text: Several reviewers report dirty cutlery, a lipstick-marked glass, a chipped plate, pests, or a musty smell.
quotes: The glass of water I was given had leftover lipstick from a previous diner.
The cutlery I had was dirty as well.

themes.label: Breakfast and menu variety
themes.text: Reviewers like the breakfast and the large menu with many options and daily specials.
quotes: The menu is huge & lots of daily specials.
Midtown Diner has a great breakfast!

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most reviewers found staff friendly, attentive and professional, though a few reported slow service, feeling rushed, a billing misunderstanding and a rude manager.
quotes: The staff is attentive and very professional. Great place...
We felt really rushed after we finished eating and there were PLENTY of empty tables available.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Reviewers frequently praised the food as delicious and fresh, naming calamari, octopus, tuna on crack, burgers and oysters, with a few complaints about prep.
quotes: Freshest clams on the half shell. Wonderful grilled octopus and tuna tartare. Fish fresh and simple.
Food is good but they need to work on quality / prep. Had numerous bones left in my fish

themes.label: Decor and atmosphere
themes.text: Many described the interior as beautiful, cozy and charming, with a marine or Hamptons theme and a fun bookcase bathroom door.
quotes: The place is a work of art !!! The interior is incredible!
The bathroom door is really fun because it is a bookcase that is mounted on a door.

themes.label: Small portions and price
themes.text: Some found portions small and pricey, while others called prices reasonable or worth it.
quotes: the portions are ridiculously small.
Super reasonable prices ... Recommended for lunch any day!

themes.label: Bar and cocktails
themes.text: Reviewers enjoyed the bar, the cocktails and friendly bartenders, including happy hour service.
quotes: I love the u-shaped bar, which made happy hour service enjoyable to watch.
The bartenders were very friendly and pretty attentive.

themes.label: Guacamole
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the guacamole as fresh, tasty and some call it the best ever, though others find it expensive for the amount served.
quotes: the guacamole is probably the best i have ever had!
Guac is expensive. $28 for a large bowl, and the bowl is large. The contents are not large.

themes.label: Drinks and margaritas
themes.text: Margaritas, bottomless drinks and the cocktail selection are widely liked, though a couple of reviewers found some drinks weak or unremarkable.
quotes: Great bottomless frozen prickly pear margaritas
The buffet drinks were virgin. Probably 2 drops of tequila? Crazy bad.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Staff are mostly described as friendly, attentive and helpful, with a few complaints about slow or careless service.
quotes: The servers were very friendly and attentive.
Food is great but service can be a bit slow

themes.label: Price and portions
themes.text: Several reviewers found portions small and prices high for what was served, though a few called portions good or prices decent.
quotes: Small portions for the price. The taste was a little blan.
Average and Overpriced. Left hungry and 30 bucks poorer.

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: The room is described as cozy, nicely decorated and lively, though one reviewer found it dark and loud.
quotes: The place is cozy and romantic
it is dark and loud so difficult to enjoy and have a conversation

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food delicious, fresh and well prepared, with pastas, octopus, gnocchi and lamb singled out, though a few say quality has slipped.
quotes: The pasta dishes are incredible.
Pastas are homemade and very delicious. Also ordered the octopus for appetizers and it's fresh.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Service is widely described as friendly, attentive and accommodating, though a few reviewers report rude or poor service.
quotes: The waiter made great suggestions on wine and food. He was friendly and very helpful.
Even when business dinners run late, they are very accommodating.

themes.label: Cozy tight space
themes.text: The room is praised as cozy, romantic and quiet, though some find it small, tight or crowded and not wheelchair accessible.
quotes: Except for the small and tight space, everything else about this Italian eatery is phenomenal.
Quiet enough to hear your tablemates without raised voices.

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Portions are called plentiful or huge, and one reviewer finds it reasonably priced, while others say it is pricey.
quotes: Servers were very friendly. Huge portions!
Apps were great service was awesome pasta was ehhh prices were high

themes.label: Outdoor seating
themes.text: Reviewers like the outdoor seating, both on warm nights and in the 2020 outdoor setup.
quotes: They did a great job with the outdoor setup.
Fantastic service and outdoor setting.

themes.label: Quality of service
themes.text: Many reviewers praise attentive, friendly staff, while others describe rude, condescending or pushy waiters and rushed or slow service.
quotes: Great service and atmosphere, even better food.
who would serve you with a condescending attitude as if you owed him money

themes.label: French bistro dishes
themes.text: Most reviewers love classics like onion soup, escargot, steak tartare and profiteroles, but a few call the food mediocre or poor.
quotes: The onion soup was one of the best we have ever had including the dozens of bowls actually in France.
Steak frites served with poor quality steak, overcooked, with gristle and limp, greasy, oily fries.

themes.label: Wine list
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the wine selection, including its breadth, wines by the glass and willingness to let diners taste.
quotes: amazing wine list, especially large selection of wines by the glass.
Cozy French bistro with an outstanding wine selection.

themes.label: Cozy bistro atmosphere
themes.text: Many describe the room as cozy, charming and authentically Parisian, though one reviewer found it cold with tightly packed tables.
quotes: Cozy restaurant with a great French café type atmosphere.
You are transported to a Paris bistro in decor, food and cozy atmosphere.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some find prices reasonable, such as the prix fixe lunch, while others call the restaurant overpriced for the food.
quotes: Really reasonable prix fixe lunch special.
Super expensive and not that outstanding
